decisions.signer: EIP-6963 injected discovery first, WalletConnect fallback for mobile/Electron
decisions.scope: All three phases: read tally, cast votes, republish + homepage winner
decisions.network: Testnet only; derive contests from the published lists manifest at runtime, nothing hardcoded

verified_facts: @bitsocial/pubsub-voting@0.4.0 is the latest release published on npm
lists/5chan-directory-criteria.jsonc is live: 64 contests, 1:1 with the 64 default directory codes, no per-contest overrides
bitsocial-seeder v0.6.0 seeds that exact manifest URL by default
5chan Pass testnet criteria now use the erc5192-min-balance soulbound gate on Base Sepolia at 0xA8e0155E0e7d014EAF3917982db6a9A4dF98C852
pkc-js 0.0.72 browser build registers pubsub: gossipsub() and fetch: libp2pFetch(); heliaNode accessor is semver-covered
better-sqlite3 already arrives via pkc-js, so pubsub-voting adds no new native dependency
pubsub-voting wants viem 2.54.0; the project resolution dedupes pubsub-voting, bitsocial-react-hooks, and bso-resolver onto viem 2.55.8
https://sepolia.base.org serves eth_call at 1,296,000 blocks deep (full 30-day expiry window) and has multicall3; base-sepolia-rpc.publicnode.com rejects archive requests
All candidate boards in the vendored directory lists carry both a .bso name and a publicKey, which is what a ballot requires
Criteria is upvote-only (voteSchema min=1 max=1) and maxVotesPerAddress=1, so the existing -1 button cannot be represented
Testnet cadence: 1800-block buckets (1h on Base Sepolia) x 720 buckets = 30 day expiry; republishIntervalBuckets = 360 buckets = ~15 days

items.description: Add @bitsocial/pubsub-voting and strip-json-comments at exact versions; add a viem resolution so the three in-tree copies dedupe to one. Confirm the browser field swaps better-sqlite3 out of the bundle.
verification: library smoke: derived 64 criteria + real topic CIDs off the live manifest
items.notes: Updated pubsub-voting to 0.4.0 + strip-json-comments 5.0.3; viem resolution 2.55.8 collapses the copies. The live and vendored manifest now use the package's registered erc5192-min-balance gate and current Pass contract. better-sqlite3 absence from the bundle is NOT yet proven - nothing imports the library in app code yet, so re-verify at F004.

items.description: Handle directory codes that have no voting contest. /trash/ has a directory list but is intentionally outside the published contest manifest, so its page must render the static list with voting cleanly unavailable rather than erroring.
verification: load /trash/ directory page and confirm no console error and no vote UI
items.notes: trash is a special board (TRASH_BOARD_CODE) and is absent from the defaults file, so excluding it is correct. /r/ was added upstream and now has a contest. Do not hardcode exclusions; drive purely off which contests the manifest actually derives.

items.description: Spike: construct a PubsubVoter in the browser against the pkc Helia node. Highest-risk unknown for the whole task; everything downstream assumes it works. Confirm no MissingPubsubError/MissingBlockstoreError/MissingFetchError.
verification: Load a directory page in playwright-cli and confirm a voter constructs with no construction error in the console
items.notes: Reach the node via account.pkc.clients.libp2pJsClients['libp2pjs'].heliaNode. Only valid in browser-libp2p runtime mode; gateway mode has no Helia node and must degrade to read-only-unavailable.

items.description: Criteria manifest loader: fetch the lists JSONC at runtime (same URL the seeder uses) with a vendored offline fallback, strip comments, run deriveDirectoryCriteria, and map contestId <-> directory code.
verification: yarn test on the new loader unit tests
items.notes: Mirror the existing use-directory-list.ts fetch/localStorage/vendored-fallback pattern. contestId shape is 5chan-dir-{code}-vote-test-1, but parse it rather than assuming the suffix.

items.description: Voter singleton + seams: ChainClientFactory (baseSepolia for the gate, eth mainnet for .bso resolution), nameResolvers from @bitsocial/bso-resolver, browser IndexedDB storage, no httpRouterUrls.
verification: unit test that an unresolvable chain recuses via MissingChainClientError
items.notes: One memoized viem PublicClient per chain so parallel contests coalesce reads. Default Base Sepolia RPC: https://sepolia.base.org (verified archive-deep).

items.description: use-vote-tally hook: createContest for the directory being viewed, subscribe to update/error, expose ranking with chainVerified/nameResolved flags. Lazy per-page, not all 64.
items.notes: Must stop() the contest on unmount to leave the topic.

items.description: Directory page read path: render tally weight into the existing score column, show a verifying state while chainVerified is false, order rows by weight. Phase 1 ships here.
items.notes: Score column already exists and currently always renders the em-dash placeholder.

items.description: Wallet connection: EIP-6963 provider discovery with EIP-1193 fallback, Zustand store for connection state, connect/disconnect UI. Warn (do not block) when the connected address differs from account.author.wallets.eth.address.
verification: playwright-cli with a mock EIP-1193 provider injected
items.notes: The library never reads the bitsocial account; the recovered signature address IS the voter.

items.description: WalletConnect fallback for mobile and Electron, behind the injected path.
verification: manual connect flow on a mobile viewport
items.notes: Adds a hosted relay dependency; keep it strictly opt-in and lazy-loaded so it stays out of the main bundle.

items.description: VoteSigner adapter: address() + signBallot(typedData) backed by a viem WalletClient.
verification: unit test against the library's frozen EIP-712 conformance vector
items.notes: pubsub-voting ships a frozen conformance vector; test against it rather than hand-rolling expectations.

items.description: Cast and withdraw: createContestVote().publish(), +1 becomes a toggle reflecting the user's current vote, remove the -1 button, surface InvalidCommunityNameError and VoteEvictedError.
verification: cast a real vote on testnet against a faucet-minted Pass and observe the tally change
items.notes: Withdraw = publish an empty ballot (LWW supersede). Downvotes are unrepresentable under this criteria.

items.description: Cast-vote persistence store: remember what this wallet voted for per contest, with the bundle blockNumber, so republish and toggle state survive reload.
items.notes: Zustand persisted store, keyed by wallet address + contestId.

items.description: Republish scheduling: compute expiry from republishIntervalBuckets and prompt the user to re-sign before a vote lapses (~15 days on testnet).
verification: unit test the bucket math against a fixed clock
items.notes: The library deliberately never republishes on its own. Needs a re-sign prompt, not a silent background signer.

items.description: Homepage: join all 64 contests and resolve each directory winner from the live tally instead of the static lists JSON, with the static list as fallback.
items.notes: Unproven cost. 64 gossipsub topics + 64 checkpoint cold-joins in a browser. Seeder raises its fetch stream cap to 256 for exactly this reason. Measure before shipping.

items.description: Translations for all new user-facing keys via the translate skill, then regenerate llms files if public-facing English content changed.
items.notes: Run translator subagents sequentially, never in parallel (update-translations.js --write is non-atomic).
